description: Changes one item: only what you send. A note is added below the item's notes (send only the text; Guest Logic starts it with the date and AI, 11/19 - AI -, itself); photo_url adds a picture; an empty field value clears it, and so does an empty code, goes, option or cart_id; decision approves or disapproves it (undecided clears it); retired true marks a replaced item: kept on record, never bought, out of every total. Owner only. Needs the owner's sign-in.

cart_id.description: The store's id for the cart button: Amazon ASIN (B0D9GB2PZP) or Walmart item id (19969702337)

code.description: Placement code: where it goes, written on its box, e.g. L01 (lobby), D01, H01, A1 (letters, digits, up to 12)

decision.description: The owner's decision on the item, only when the owner gave it

goes.description: Where it goes, in words, e.g. "Net over the front desk; trees"

notes.description: A note to add, the text only (no date or AI stamp)

option.description: Option group letter (A, B…): a design option of a space, out of the cart until the owner picks it in the Design phase; empty clears

photo_url.description: Public https address of a picture

retired.description: true: replaced, do not buy (kept on record, out of every total); false: back in the list

name: update_project_item
title: Change a project item
